description: Discord member moderation. Actions: info, kick, ban, unban, timeout, nickname.

action.description: Action: info, kick, ban, unban, timeout, nickname.

delete_days.description: Days of messages to delete, 0-7 (ban action, default 0).

duration.description: Timeout duration in minutes (timeout action). 0 to remove timeout.

guild_id.description: Guild ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID env var.

member.description: User name, tag, or ID (required for all actions).

nickname.description: New nickname (nickname action). Empty string to reset.

name: discord_member
